description.value: Express Pizza is a Maple Ridge pizza shop serving the Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows area with hand-tossed pizzas made from fresh-sliced vegetables, original dough, and premium ingredients slow-baked in a traditional oven. The menu spans classic and specialty pies including Butter Chicken and Souvlaki options, with gluten-free crusts available. Late evening hours make it a viable stop for cyclists finishing a long day on the road.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 47m; stands (5 spaces) at 52m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and provides clear evidence for address (11945 – 224th Street, Maple Ridge BC), phone ((604) 477-1480), and menu details. Takeout is confirmed by the prominent 'ORDER ONLINE NOW' CTA and the fast_food OSM tag; vegetarian and gluten-free options are explicitly named on the menu. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
